thread:
Meera: Heads up — demo on Friday needs standby GPUs in eu-west. Vendor said they can hold some slots but we need to confirm exact quota and any blackout windows. Can ppl confirm: 1) how many A100/H100 we can lock as standby, 2) whether vendor accepts 2-hr short-borrows, and 3) PO/chargeback required?

Tom: Vendor update: they can hold up to 6 A100 standby in eu-west and 4 H100 but firmware batch is rolling next week. They said short-borrows (<=2h) are OK if scheduled 24h ahead. Need PO number + expected start/end times.

Lena: For PO, use billing code `INFRA-DEMO-2026`. If it's <24h we can do an internal journal entry but prefer a PO. Also confirm chargebacks to project `demo-platform`.

Jason: For fallback: we can fall back to preemptible pool in us-west if eu-west fails, but latency will spike. Quick check command I ran: `gcloud compute reservations list --filter=\"name:demo-standby*\" --regions=eu-west1` shows nothing reserved atm. If we need immediate reserve, we should create a reservation via terraform.

Carla: Can we request borrowing 2 A100 for Friday 10:00-12:00 UTC from that standby pool? That's for the live canary run.

Tom: Yes we can schedule that as long as vendor gets 24h notice. I'll ping them to tentatively hold 2 A100 for 10:00-12:00 UTC Fri. Please confirm PO or internal journal.

Meera: I'll file the schedule in ticket #1234 and tag @Lena for PO. Carla — hold that time until we get vendor confirmation.

Lena: Sounds good. I'll try to push an expedited PO; if it's delayed we can do a journal for the demo and reconcile after.

infra-bot: Reservation draft created: demo-standby-eu-west-2a (status: PENDING). See: https://rdrw.internal/reservations/DRFT-9876

Tom: Vendor replied — standby slots tentatively held, firmware window may affect H100s around 03:00-07:00 UTC Saturday, A100 unaffected. They requested the PO by EOD tomorrow.

Meera: Action items: 1) @Lena submit PO or journal by EOD tomorrow, 2) @Tom confirm vendor hold when PO sent, 3) @Carla keep canary on calendar 10:00-12:00 Fri, 4) @Jason prepare preemptible fallback script and runbook. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Carla: Will keep it blocked on my calendar and prep the test vectors.

Jason: I'll add fallback commands to the runbook and flag the playbook with the latency caveat. Pushing a small terraform snippet if we need quick reservation:

```hcl
resource \"google_compute_reservation\" \"demo_standby\" {
  name     = \"demo-standby-eu-west-2a\"
  project  = \"infra-demo-project\"
  region   = \"europe-west1\"
  specific_reservation {
    instance_properties {
      guest_accelerator {
        accelerator_count = 2
        accelerator_type  = \"nvidia-tesla-a100\"
      }
    }
    count = 2
  }
}
```

Meera: Perfect. I'll update ticket #1234 with these notes and close once PO confirmed. Thanks all!
